body:
me too... I like seeing my paths. I've been messing with the custom shell cmd directives for a few hours now... the docs are a bit opaque. I got it working, I think.

![Screen Shot 2022-03-16 at 17 18 19](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/57006/158712423-9654ed7f-0960-49ab-88aa-0aa36fd786ff.png)

```toml
# ~/.config/starship.toml
#
# `[custom.homedir]` takes current path and abbreviates `$HOME` substring w `~\` if possible

format = """$sudo\
$username$hostname\
${custom.homedir}\
$character""" 
# $line_break\

right_format = """$git_branch\
$git_state \
$git_status \
$cmd_duration$status$time\
$python"""

# Disable the blank line at the start of the prompt
# add_newline = true
# Wait 10 milliseconds for starship to check files under the current directory.
scan_timeout = 10
# Timeout for commands executed by starship (in milliseconds).
command_timeout = 500

[username]
style_user = "purple bg:black"
style_root = "orange bg:purple"
format = "[$user]($style)"
disabled = false
show_always = false

[hostname]
format = "@[$hostname](bold black)"
trim_at = ".companyname.com"
ssh_only = true
disabled = false

[custom.homedir]
command = 'echo "${PWD/$(echo $HOME)/~}"'
format = "[$output]($style)"
shell = "bash"
style = "green"
when = "true"

[fill]
style = "yellow"
# symbol = "-"
symbol = "."

[status]
disabled = false
format = '[\[$common_meaning$signal_name$signal_number$maybe_int\]]($style)'
map_symbol = true
style = "red bold"
symbol = "✘"

[sudo]
disabled = false
style = "bold green"
symbol = "🧙 "

[git_branch]
format = "[on $branch]($style)"
style = "bright-black"

[git_state]
format = '\([$state( $progress_current/$progress_total)]($style)\) '
style = "bright-black"

[git_status]
# format = "[[(*$conflicted$untracked$modified$staged$renamed$deleted)](218) ($ahead_behind$stashed)]($style)"
# format = "([\[$all_status$ahead_behind\]]($style) )'"
format = '([\[$ahead_behind\]]($style) )'
ahead = "⇡${count}"
diverged = "⇕⇡${ahead_count}⇣${behind_count}"
behind = "⇣${count}"
conflicted = "​"
deleted = "​"
modified = "​"
renamed = "​"
staged = "​"
stashed = "≡"
style = "cyan"
untracked = "​"

[time]
disabled = false
format = '[$time]($style)'
style = "brblack"
time_format = "%T"
# utc_time_offset = "-5"
# time_range = "10:00:00-14:00:00"

[cmd_duration]
format = "[$duration]($style) "
style = "yellow"

[python]
format = "[$virtualenv]($style) "
pyenv_version_name = true
python_binary = ["./venv/bin/python", "python3", "python2", "python"]
style = "bright-black"

[character]
error_symbol = "[❯](red)"
success_symbol = "[❯](purple)"
vicmd_symbol = "[❮](green)"




#################################################
### previous experimnents, unused currently

[env_var.SHELL]
disabled = true
variable = "STARSHIP_SHELL"
default = "fish"
format = '[\[$output]\]($style)'
style = "grey"

[directory]
disabled = true
```
